content: As a software developer maintaining the GitHub repository pulp-platform_axi_pr245, you are responsible for analyzing a submitted issue and identifying the exact location in the repository where the issue occurs.

Here is the issue description:
# Tie mst_w_chan to '0 when mst_w_valid!=0.
https://github.com/pulp-platform/axi/blob/64ca21eb2ffcc26ed9b7635d19723fa227f38699/src/axi_lite_mux.sv#L286
The muxes seem redundant. Is it on purpose?
If not, we can remove the muxes, right?
`assign mst_w_chan      =  slv_reqs_i[w_select].w;`

216     // control of the AW channel
217     always_comb begin
218       // default assignments
219       lock_aw_valid_d = lock_aw_valid_q;
220       load_aw_lock    = 1'b0;
221       w_fifo_push     = 1'b0;
222       mst_aw_valid    = 1'b0;
223       aw_ready        = 1'b0;
224       // had a downstream stall, be valid and send the AW along
225       if (lock_aw_valid_q) begin
226         mst_aw_valid = 1'b1;
227         // transaction
228         if (mst_aw_ready) begin
229           aw_ready        = 1'b1;
230           lock_aw_valid_d = 1'b0;
231           load_aw_lock    = 1'b1;
232         end
233       end else begin
234         if (!w_fifo_full && aw_valid) begin
235           mst_aw_valid = 1'b1;
236           w_fifo_push = 1'b1;
237           if (mst_aw_ready) begin
238             aw_ready = 1'b1;
239           end else begin
240             // go to lock if transaction not in this cycle
241             lock_aw_valid_d = 1'b1;
242             load_aw_lock    = 1'b1;
243           end
244         end
245       end
246     end
